cta.line_en: See each platform's confirmed rebate terms on the NexuAlpha compare page, then decide. Sign-up buttons there are partner links; the exchange pays the commission. Rebates lower costs, not risk.

meta.review_notes: 【需业主确认】返还比例取自 partners.json（termsConfirmedOn 2026-10-10）：Bitget 60%、OKX 40%、Binance 25%；Bybit share=null，不写比例。脚本写成'返还比例'，需确认基数是'交易所支付的佣金'还是'你付的手续费'，确认后在页面注明。'最高 60%'与 maxSharePct=60 一致。'邀请码只能在注册时填写，之后不能补填'依据 OKX 推荐计划 FAQ，其他平台规则以官方为准。坦诚说明 NexuAlpha 的收入来源。

page.summary_zh: 你在交易所的成本包括交易手续费、点差、提币网络费，做合约还有资金费率。返佣是交易所的正式推荐计划：用推荐码注册后，交易所从手续费中拿出一部分返给推荐方和你，钱由交易所支付。NexuAlpha 的收入来自这类推荐佣金。按 2026-10-10 确认的条款，返还比例为 Bitget 60%、OKX 40%、Binance 25%；返佣只降低成本，不降低风险，也不应成为多交易的理由。
checklist_zh: 算过交易费、点差、提币费的总和
知道返佣由交易所支付
注册时就填写推荐码（之后通常不能补填）
在官方条款中确认返佣比例和条件
不为了返佣增加交易次数

options: 交易所，从手续费中拿出一部分
quiz.answer: 交易所，从手续费中拿出一部分
quiz.why: 返佣是交易所推荐计划的一部分，用户不额外付费。

quiz.q: 推荐码一般什么时候填写？
quiz.why: 例如 OKX 规定推荐关系只能在注册时建立，之后不能添加或修改。

quiz.q: 关于返佣，哪句话是对的？
options: 只降低成本，不降低风险
quiz.answer: 只降低成本，不降低风险
quiz.why: 返佣抵扣的是部分手续费，价格波动的风险不会因此减少。

faq.a: 正规返佣是交易所官方的推荐计划，钱来自交易所收取的手续费。要警惕的是承诺"高返佣 + 高杠杆"、诱导频繁交易的推广。
用户通过我们的合作推广链接注册时，交易所会向我们支付推荐佣金，并按条款把一部分返还给用户。你不需要额外付费。

faq.q: 已经注册的账户能补填邀请码吗？
faq.a: 通常不能。以 OKX 为例，推荐关系只能在注册时建立。其他平台以官方规则为准。

page.summary_en: Your exchange costs include trading fees, spread, withdrawal network fees, and funding rates if you trade futures. A rebate is an exchange referral programme: after you register with a referral code, the exchange returns part of collected fees to the referrer and to you. The exchange pays it. NexuAlpha earns revenue from this kind of referral commission. Under terms confirmed on 2026-10-10, rebate shares are Bitget 60%, OKX 40%, and Binance 25%. Rebates reduce costs; they do not reduce risk and should not be a reason to trade more.
checklist_en: I have added up trading fees, spread, and withdrawal fees
I know rebates are paid by the exchange
I enter the referral code during registration because it usually cannot be added later
I confirm rebate percentages and conditions in the official terms
I do not increase trading frequency for rebates

options: The exchange, from part of the fees it collects
The referrer pays out of pocket
quiz_en.answer: The exchange, from part of the fees it collects
quiz_en.why: Rebates are part of exchange referral programmes, and users do not pay extra for them.

quiz_en.q: When do you usually need to enter a referral code?
quiz_en.why: For example, OKX says the referral relationship can only be established at registration and cannot be added or changed later.

quiz_en.q: Which statement about rebates is correct?
options: They can make trading reliably profitable
The more you trade, the safer it gets
quiz_en.why: A rebate offsets part of the fee. It does not reduce price-volatility risk.

faq_en.a: A legitimate rebate is an official exchange referral programme, funded from fees the exchange collects. Be cautious of promotions that combine high rebates with high leverage or push frequent trading.
When users sign up through our partner links, the exchange pays us referral commission and returns part to users under the terms. You do not pay extra.

faq_en.q: Can an existing account add an invite code later?
faq_en.a: Usually not. For example, OKX establishes referral relationships only during registration. Other platforms depend on their official rules.
